structure_and_depth.location: Complete analysis/outline.md, numbered items 1-9 and materials/dependency paragraphs; original ev_batteries_zh.json; assignment effective requirements, production_history and retained outline snapshot.
structure_and_depth.basis: The argument has a usable causal sequence: vehicle constraints and classification -> material/cell/pack mechanisms -> charging, cold and aging protocols -> system safety -> saleable-pack cost -> joint sensitivities -> manufacturing evidence -> four conditional vehicle choices. Items 2, 5 and 6 connect the performance-cost matrix to actual configurations, yield/utilization and usable capacity instead of comparing unrelated best figures. Item 7 separates samples, validation, SOP, deliveries and continuing supply, giving item 8 a maturity constraint as well as a laboratory-performance constraint. All requested deliverables and vehicle categories have an analytical role; no section is only a vendor list. Relevant original-source checks support the planned protocol distinction: EVB21 ADAC test-method passages specify 0 C chamber, 14-18 h conditioning, 300 kW charger limits and DC-loss-inclusive consumption, while EVB22 NAF charging passages specify approximately -10 C at charging and two-hour battery preheating after the colder drive. The outline appropriately uses those cases to explain limits rather than merging them into a chemistry ranking. Its identified missing cost/lifetime originals remain research dependencies, not asserted completed results. I inspected the single recorded outline-stage history and its retained complete draft; it matches the assigned artifact and does not claim later production stages. No substantive structure/depth defect requires an outline revision. This pass concerns the research plan only; the complete report still has to execute the promised evidence, calculations and synthesis.
